test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Who am I and _______ am I? A nobody, not wanted by any one, nor of use to anybody.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question is asking for **a word that logically fits in the blank to complete the sentence meaningfully.**
 
• The correct word should be a question word that pairs well with **"Who am I"** to inquire further about **the identity or nature of the person.**
 
• **"What" **is the most appropriate question word because **it asks about the identity or role of the person.**
 
• The correct answer is **"What".**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Who am I and **what** am I? A nobody, not wanted by any one, nor of use to anybody."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **When:** This word typically refers to time and is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Why:** This word asks for a reason or purpose and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Whom:** This word is used to refer to the object of a verb or preposition and does not fit the context of the sentence.
